evidence.title: GitHub - jakobhoeg/enhanced-button: An enhanced version of the default shadcn-button component · GitHub

name: enhanced-button
summary: Drop-in shadcn/ui button expansion adding effects like shine, gooey, ring hover and gradient slideshow.
description: An enhanced version of the shadcn/ui button: replace button.tsx and extend tailwind.config to get one button component with extra effect variants — expandIcon, ringHover, shine, shineHover, gooeyRight, gooeyLeft, underline, hoverUnderline and gradientSlideShow — plus icon placement handling, so a project does not manage several button components.
contains: copy button.tsx and tailwind.config lines into a shadcn/ui project
effect variants: shine, shineHover, ringHover, gooeyLeft/Right, underline, hoverUnderline, expandIcon, gradientSlideShow
icon prop with left/right placement and expand animation
